name: zep-locale-dbc
description: Locale-tree DBC overrides. Some DBCs (Movie/MovieVariation/MovieFileData) are shipped by Blizzard in LOCALE patch archives, which outrank a root Data/PATCH-*.MPQ, so our PATCH-Z copies are shadowed and never read (I-280). Those must be delivered as Data/<locale>/patch-<locale>-<N>.MPQ instead. DISABLED: the build pipeline can only emit Data/PATCH-<letter>.MPQ, so this package is packed manually with `mpq-tools pack -o` and placed by hand until locale delivery exists.
author: Zeppelin Team
